互联网泡沫顶前 9 个月

summary.verdict_desc:
**一句话**：美联储三年来首次加息落地、10 年美债破 5%，广度一周内从 38.8 塌到 27.8，Oracle $180 亿数据中心贷款被报价 89-91 美分——破裂临近度首次进入「引线点燃」区间，判读维持高风险预警。

**政策面**：9/16 FOMC 以 12-0 票加息 25bp 至 3.75-4.00%，为 2023 年以来首次；点阵图 18 人中 16 人认为年内还有一次、4 人看两次，CME 对 10/28 再加息定价 59.7%。10 年美债周内升破 5.006%，为 2007 年 7 月以来最高。加息从「定价」变成「已发生」，是本体系里唯一由预期兑现为事实的 trigger。

**广度**：S5FI 从 9/11 的 38.76 一路跌到 9/18 收 27.83（日线 37.77→34.59→30.81→30.81→27.83），两周 -28.2%，全市场口径 50 日线上方仅 31.4%、200 日线上方 43.2%。同期纳指周涨 0.7%、标普周跌 0.1%，道指周跌 1.7% 为三连阴、3 月以来最差，而标普前五权重反而升 0.26pt 至 28.01%。指数靠少数权重撑住、内部已在下跌——这正是 2000-02 与 2021-11 共有的形态。

**信用面**：本期最重要的边际变化在这里。Oracle 新墨西哥 Project Jupiter 的约 $180 亿银团贷款被报价 89-91 美分、已入压力区间，起因是许可与电力问题（含 2.2GW 燃气轮机申请被否）致项目延期约七个月，Santander、Jefferies 等被迫留券、分销停滞；dc_abs_spread 由黄转红，是本轮第一次有旗舰级 AI 数据中心债务在二级被明确折价。CoreWeave 同周把可转债从 $30 亿上调到 $37 亿发出，债务权益比抬至 14.3。但 HY OAS 仍是 270bps——项目级信用在裂、指数级信用毫发无伤，这个分化本身就是信息：引线点燃了，火还没烧到干草堆。

**反向证据**：需求侧仍无裂缝。OpenRouter 近 30 日 509.9T token 首破 500T、环比 +74.2%、绝对量周环比再 +10.1%，增速连续第 5 期抬升；H100 现货中位 $3.25/hr、90 日还涨约 7%，新代芯片可得性仅 7-16%，没有 2000 年暗光纤式塌价；Oracle RPO $6640 亿配 OCI +121% 的转化仍在；前沿能力 90 天位移依旧巨大（ARC-AGI-3 7.8%→62.7%）。基本面 6 项 5 绿 1 黄，是整套体系唯一干净的板块——不过本期也是本轮第一次出现「零新 SOTA + 零旗舰发布」的组合，值得连续跟踪。

**判读**：红灯 9/25 = 36.0%（上期 32.0%），加权风险分 52.0（上期 48.0）。基础档位为中度警戒，因估值红灯 2 项（CAPE 40.94、前五权重 28.01%）与资金面红灯 3 项（Mag4 FCF、VC 占比、NVDA 客户投资）同时成立，触发①估值 + 资金面双类共振强制升级至高风险预警；两轴升级②未触发（stage 60.0 达标，trigger 46.7 未及 50）。两轴：泡沫成熟度 60.0（亢奋）持平，破裂临近度由 40.0 升至 46.7，首次进入「引线点燃」区间。与 2000-02（顶前 1 个月）相似度升至 80%，仍是最像的历史时点；主要差异集中在 NVDA 远期 PE（18.5x 绿 vs 当年龙头红）、HY 利差（270bps 绿 vs 当年黄）与全部基本面绿灯——反过来说 dc_abs_spread 已比当时更差。本周恶化 2 项、好转 0 项（净 +2），未达「边际恶化加速」的 +4 门槛。
summary.verdict_desc_en:
**Bottom line**: The Fed hiked for the first time in three years, the 10-year cleared 5%, breadth fell from 38.8 to 27.8 in a week, and $18bn of Oracle data centre loans were quoted at 89-91 cents. The trigger axis entered Fuse Lit territory for the first time; the verdict stays High Risk Alert.

**Policy**: The FOMC voted 12-0 on September 16 to raise rates 25bp to 3.75-4.00%, the first increase since 2023. The dot plot showed 16 of 18 participants expecting another hike this year and four seeing two more, and CME futures put the odds of a further move on October 28 at 59.7%. The 10-year Treasury traded through 5.006%, its highest since July 2007. Tightening has moved from priced to realised — the only one of the 25 indicators here to have made that transition.

**Breadth**: S5FI fell from 38.76 on September 11 to 27.83 on September 18, printing 37.77, 34.59, 30.81, 30.81 and 27.83 along the way, down 28.2% in a fortnight. Across the broad US tape only 31.4% of stocks sit above their 50-day average and 43.2% above their 200-day. Yet the Nasdaq rose 0.7% on the week and the S&P slipped just 0.1%; only the Dow fell meaningfully, down 1.7% for a third straight losing week. Meanwhile the S&P's top-five weight rose 0.26pt to 28.01%. An index carried by a handful of names while the average stock declines is the shape both February 2000 and November 2021 took.

**Credit**: This is where the important change happened. Roughly $18bn of syndicated loans behind Oracle's Project Jupiter in New Mexico now trades at 89-91 cents, stressed territory, after permitting and power problems — including a rejected application tied to 2.2GW of gas turbines — delayed the project about seven months, leaving Santander, Jefferies and others holding paper they intended to sell. The data centre ABS indicator moved from amber to red on it: this is the first time in the cycle flagship AI infrastructure debt has been visibly marked below par. CoreWeave upsized a convertible from $3.0bn to $3.7bn in the same week with debt-to-equity now at 14.3. And yet high-yield OAS sits at 270bps, unchanged. Project-level credit is cracking while index credit is untouched — the fuse is lit, the fire has not reached the haystack, and that divergence is itself the signal.

**Contrary evidence**: Demand shows no crack at all. OpenRouter's trailing 30-day volume cleared 500 trillion tokens for the first time at 509.9 trillion, up 74.2% on the prior 30 days and 10.1% week on week, with the growth rate accelerating for a fifth consecutive period. Median spot H100 rental sits at $3.25 an hour and is up roughly 7% over 90 days, with confirmed availability of the newest silicon at just 7-16% — nothing resembling the dark-fibre collapse of 2000. Oracle's $664bn backlog is converting at 121% OCI growth. Frontier capability displacement over 90 days remains enormous, with ARC-AGI-3 going from 7.8% to 62.7%. Five of six fundamentals indicators are green, the only clean block in the framework — though this was also the first week of the cycle with no new SOTA and no flagship release, which is worth tracking.

**Verdict**: Nine of 25 reds gives a 36.0% risk temperature, up from 32.0%, with a weighted risk score of 52.0 against 48.0. The base band is Moderate Caution, but two valuation reds (CAPE at 40.94, top-five weight at 28.01%) alongside three capital reds (Mag4 free cash flow, AI's share of VC, Nvidia's customer investments) trip rule one, the valuation-plus-capital resonance override, forcing the reading up to High Risk Alert. The two-axis override did not fire: stage cleared its 60 threshold at 60.0 but trigger reached only 46.7 against the 50 required. On the axes themselves, bubble maturity held at 60.0 (Euphoria) while proximity to rupture rose from 40.0 to 46.7, entering Fuse Lit for the first time. Similarity to February 2000, one month before the dot-com top, rose to 80% and remains the closest historical analogue. The gaps are Nvidia's forward multiple (green at 18.5x where the 1999 leaders were red), high-yield spreads (green at 270bps versus amber then) and the entire fundamentals block — though on data centre credit we are now worse than February 2000 was. Two indicators deteriorated and none improved, a net of +2, short of the +4 that would flag accelerating deterioration.

wow_changes.note: 数据中心 ABS 由黄转红：Oracle Project Jupiter 约 $180 亿银团贷款被报价 89-91 美分，项目延期七个月、承销行被迫留券，本轮首次出现旗舰 AI 数据中心债务二级折价。
wow_changes.note_en: Data centre ABS went from amber to red: about $18bn of syndicated loans for Oracle's Project Jupiter is quoted at 89-91 cents after a seven-month delay left underwriters holding paper — the first time flagship AI infrastructure debt has been marked below par this cycle.

wow_changes.note: 资本开支市场反应由奖励转为偶发惩罚：Oracle 9/18 收跌 3.8%、CoreWeave 9/17 跌 4-5% 跌破 $80，市场开始评判偿付 capex 的债而非 capex 本身。
wow_changes.note_en: The market's response to capex turned from reward to selective punishment: Oracle closed down 3.8% on September 18 and CoreWeave fell 4-5% below $80 on September 17. Investors are now judging the debt that funds the capex rather than the capex itself.

wow_changes.note: 广度两周塌陷 28.2%：S5FI 由 38.76 跌至 27.83，为本轮最陡的一次；同期指数几乎没跌、前五权重反而抬升。
wow_changes.note_en: Breadth collapsed 28.2% in a fortnight, S5FI falling from 38.76 to 27.83, the steepest drop of the cycle — while the indices barely moved and the top-five weight actually rose.

wow_changes.note: 需求侧继续加速：30 日 token 绝对量首破 500T 至 509.9T（周环比 +10.1%），环比增速 70.1%→74.2% 连续第 5 期抬升。
wow_changes.note_en: Demand kept accelerating: trailing 30-day token volume cleared 500 trillion for the first time at 509.9 trillion, up 10.1% week on week, with month-over-month growth rising from 70.1% to 74.2% for a fifth straight period.

wow_changes.note: 比值由 3171x 跳到 7327x，但全部来自买盘从 $29.6 万塌到 $12.18 万；卖出绝对额其实 $9.383 亿→$8.928 亿、环比 -4.9%，为连续 4 期抬升后首次回落。
wow_changes.note_en: The ratio jumped from 3,171x to 7,327x, but entirely because purchases collapsed from $296k to $122k. Dollar sales actually fell from $938.3m to $892.8m, down 4.9% and the first decline after four straight weekly increases.

indicators.threshold_text_en: >35 red / 25-35 yellow / <25 green
indicators.note: multpl.com 主源连续第 2 期可达：页面顶部读数 40.94（截至 9/18 收盘，日内 -0.05/-0.12%），较上期 41.09 小幅回落 0.15。仍高于 35 红线约 17%，处 1881 年以来 98.8 分位、历史均值 17.42 的 2.35 倍，仅次于 1999-2000 峰值 44.19。本周标普周跌 0.1%，估值端没有跟随广度一起下移。
indicators.note_en: multpl.com stayed reachable for a second week, printing 40.94 as of the September 18 close, a 0.15-point dip from last week's 41.09. That is still about 17% above the 35 red line, in the 98.8th percentile since 1881 and 2.35x the 17.42 long-run mean, behind only the 44.19 peak of 1999-2000. With the S&P down just 0.1% on the week, valuation did not follow breadth lower.

indicators.name_zh: 标普前 5 大权重占比
indicators.threshold_text_en: >25 red / 18-25 yellow / <18 green
indicators.note: SSGA SPY 官方持仓（slickcharts 仍 403）：前五单类合计 28.01%（NVDA 8.07 / AAPL 7.51 / MSFT 5.61 / AMZN 3.73 / GOOGL 3.09），较上期 27.75% 回升 0.26pt，增量几乎全部来自 AAPL 7.33→7.51；含 Alphabet 双类 30.48%（上期 30.14%），top10 38.49%（上期 38.15%）。在 S5FI 跌到 27.83 的同一周里集中度反而抬升——指数是被前五顶住的。仍是 2000 年峰值约 18% 的 1.56 倍。
indicators.note_en: From SSGA's official SPY holdings file (slickcharts still 403s), the top five single-class names total 28.01% — Nvidia 8.07, Apple 7.51, Microsoft 5.61, Amazon 3.73, Alphabet 3.09 — up 0.26pt from 27.75%, with almost all of the gain coming from Apple's move to 7.51 from 7.33. Counting both Alphabet classes the figure is 30.48% and the top ten 38.49%, both higher than last week. Concentration rose in the same week breadth collapsed to 27.83, which is rather the point: the index is being held up by its five largest names. That is roughly 1.56x the 18% peak of 2000.

indicators.threshold_text_en: >40 red / 30-40 yellow / <30 green
indicators.note: StockAnalysis 9/20 刷新页面给出明确的 forward P/E 18.45（股价 $222.27，9/18 收盘；TTM EPS $7.91、trailing PE 28.11），较上期同源 18.12 回升 0.33，主要由股价 $218.29→$222.27 推动而非盈利预期下修。FinanceCharts 25.64（8/28）、GuruFocus 24.50（8/19）仍为财报前后旧读数，取中枢约 22x。绝对水平仍远低于 1999 年 MSFT 的 60x——本轮龙头贵在市值与指数权重，不在倍数，这也是当前向量与 2000-02 最大的一处不同。
indicators.note_en: StockAnalysis refreshed on September 20 with an explicit forward P/E of 18.45 on a $222.27 share price (the September 18 close), against trailing EPS of $7.91 and a trailing P/E of 28.11. That is up from 18.12 a week ago, driven by the share price moving from $218.29 rather than by any cut to forward earnings. FinanceCharts at 25.64 (August 28) and GuruFocus at 24.50 (August 19) remain pre- and post-earnings leftovers, so the working midpoint stays near 22x. In absolute terms that is still far below Microsoft's 60x in 1999 — this cycle's leader is expensive in market cap and index weight, not in multiple, and it is the single biggest gap between today's vector and February 2000.

indicators.threshold_text: 转折价（低于最近一轮 5%+）或标价明显下跌 红 / 溢价收窄且卖压>买压 黄 / 溢价稳定或扩大 绿
indicators.threshold_text_en: Marks below last round by 5%+ or clearly falling red / premium narrowing with sellers outweighing buyers yellow / premium stable or widening green
indicators.note: Anthropic 9/20 二级报价 $1,046.03/股、隐含 $8851.8 亿，较 $9650 亿 Series H 折价 8.27%（上期 Hiive 口径为折价 8.8%，边际微幅收窄）；Nasdaq Private Market 9/4 的 $804.75 仍是更低的一档。值得注意的是 Hiive 本期已不再对外挂 Anthropic 报价（页面改为「暂不接受新投资」），上期作为反证的 Caplight $1.2-1.4 万亿是 9/3 旧读、本期未刷新。OpenAI 侧两个平台同时冻结：Forge $721.85（隐含 $8943.3 亿、较 $8520 亿一级溢价 5.0%）连续第 4 期逐位未动，Hiive $737.24 同样未动。一边折价、一边报价停摆，尚无第二个活跃平台确认折价，维持黄灯；再有一个活跃平台确认折价即触发红线。
indicators.note_en: Anthropic's secondary mark stood at $1,046.03 a share on September 20, an implied $885.2bn and an 8.27% discount to the $965bn Series H, marginally narrower than last week's 8.8% read on Hiive. Nasdaq Private Market's $804.75 from September 4 sits lower still. Two things shifted underneath. Hiive has stopped publishing an Anthropic quote at all, its page now saying the company is not accepting new investment, and the Caplight $1.2-1.4trn print that argued the other way last week is a September 3 reading that has not been refreshed. On the OpenAI side both venues are frozen — Forge at $721.85, an implied $894.3bn and a 5.0% premium to the $852bn primary, for a fourth straight week, with Hiive also unchanged at $737.24. A discount on one name and stalled quotes on the other, with no second live venue confirming the markdown, keeps this amber; one more live platform printing a discount trips it red.

indicators.name_zh: 超大规模厂商资本开支同比
indicators.threshold_text: 下调指引 红 / 加速 黄 / 稳健 绿
indicators.threshold_text_en: Guidance cut red / accelerating yellow / steady green
indicators.note: 本期新入账的读点是容量口径而非金额口径：Bloomberg 9/10 报道微软计划把全球数据中心容量由当前约 12GW 扩到 2032 年 38GW 以上（三倍以上），其中 AI 专用容量从 2GW 升至总量的约三分之一；微软自身 capex 由 FY25 的 $1159 亿升至 FY26 的 $1453 亿、2027 年估约 $1750 亿。金额侧台账不变：big4 2026E $7250 亿、同比 +77%（2025 为 $4100 亿），Goldman 2027 全行业 $1.01 万亿（+32%），Oracle 维持 FY27 $900-950 亿指引。仍是无一家下调、口径持续上修，且开始以 2032 年为单位做产能承诺——加速本身即黄。
indicators.note_en: This week's new input is capacity rather than dollars. Bloomberg reported on September 10 that Microsoft plans to more than triple global data centre capacity from roughly 12GW today to over 38GW by 2032, with AI-dedicated capacity rising from 2GW to about a third of that footprint. Microsoft's own capex path runs $115.9bn in FY25 to $145.3bn in FY26 and an estimated $175bn for 2027. The dollar ledger is unchanged: big-four 2026 capex of $725bn, up 77% from $410bn in 2025; Goldman's $1.01trn industry figure for 2027, up 32%; and Oracle holding FY27 guidance at $90-95bn. Nobody has cut, every revision is upward, and commitments are now being framed out to 2032. Acceleration on that scale is itself the amber signal.

indicators.threshold_text_en: ≤-20 red / -20 to 0 yellow / >0 green
indicators.note: 季度 FCF 台账不变（META $7.84 亿 / AMZN TTM -$76 亿 / MSFT $196 亿 / GOOGL -$58.55 亿 / ORCL Q1FY27 -$50 亿），下一读点为 10 月下旬 Q3。本期两条新硬数据把「自有燃料耗尽」具体化：① Oracle 截至 8/31 总借款 $1253 亿，另披露约 $2610-2880 亿尚未起租的数据中心租约——这笔表外承诺是其年收入的数倍，且锁定 15-20 年；② 伦敦信用对冲基金 Sona 把全行业 AI 相关融资绘成 $3.6 万亿、176 笔、202 个主体的图谱，其中约 120 笔被判定为高度循环（同一批公司互为投资人、客户与供应商）。现金流缺口已不再只靠发债填，而是靠租约与 SPV 往后递延。
indicators.note_en: The quarterly free-cash-flow ledger is unchanged — Meta $784m, Amazon minus $7.6bn on a trailing basis, Microsoft $19.6bn, Alphabet minus $5.855bn and Oracle at minus $5.0bn for Q1 FY27 — with the next read due with Q3 results in late October. Two new hard numbers made the fuel-gauge problem concrete. Oracle carried $125.3bn of borrowings as of August 31 and separately disclosed roughly $261-288bn of data centre leases that have not yet commenced, an off-balance-sheet commitment several times annual revenue and locked in for 15 to 20 years. And Sona Asset Management, a London credit fund, mapped $3.6trn of AI-related financing across 176 deals and 202 entities, flagging about 120 of them as highly circular, with the same companies appearing as investor, customer and supplier. The cash shortfall is no longer bridged by bonds alone but by leases and SPVs.
indicators.source_name: Q2 2026 filings / Oracle 10-Q / Sona Asset Management

indicators.threshold_text_en: >50 red / 30-50 yellow / <30 green
indicators.note: 本期终于拿到 Q3 口径的新读数：PitchBook Q3 2026 报告给出年初至今 AI 占全部创投交易额 65%，并首次披露企业投资人已占美国 AI 创投交易额的 87.9%（历史新高，即这轮的边际资金主要来自战略方而非财务 LP）。主锚 H1 口径维持不变（全球 70%、美国 86%，美国 H1 总额 $4127 亿中 AI $3559 亿）。YTD 65% 低于 H1 的 70%，是这一指标本轮第一次出现的边际回落信号，但仍是健康水位 <30% 的 2.2 倍，红灯不变。
indicators.note_en: A genuine Q3 read finally landed. PitchBook's Q3 2026 report puts AI at 65% of all venture deal value year to date and, for the first time, shows corporate investors accounting for a record 87.9% of US AI venture deal value — meaning the marginal dollar in this cycle is strategic money rather than financial LPs. The half-year anchor is unchanged at 70% globally and 86% in the US, where $355.9bn of the $412.7bn deployed in H1 went to AI. The 65% year-to-date figure sits below the 70% H1 mark, the first hint of moderation this indicator has produced in this cycle, but it is still 2.2x the sub-30% healthy level and the reading stays red.

indicators.name_zh: 英伟达客户投资占收入比
indicators.threshold_text_en: >30 red / 15-30 yellow / <15 green
indicators.note: 连续第 23 期红灯，分母 LTM 收入 $3050 亿不变、分子承诺口径仍约 $1310 亿。本期新证据来自 Sona 的 $3.6 万亿融资图谱：176 笔交易中约 120 笔被判定为高度循环，NVDA 对 OpenAI 的条件性承诺被列为最高约 $1000 亿（与 SEC 文件里俄亥俄背书上限 $1050 亿互证），而 OpenAI 又向 Oracle 等云厂承诺数千亿、后者再回头买 NVDA 芯片——这次是第三方把环路画成了图。二阶方向仍是收敛：直接股权承诺自 5 月起停在约 $400 亿（OpenAI $300 亿、Anthropic $100 亿、xAI 最多 $20 亿），黄仁勋 3 月即称 $300 亿那笔「可能是最后一次开支票」。存量仍是 Lucent 1999 年 vendor financing 24% 的近一倍。
indicators.note_en: Twenty-third consecutive red. The denominator holds at $305bn of trailing revenue and the commitment-basis numerator at roughly $131bn. The new evidence came from Sona's $3.6trn financing map: of 176 deals, about 120 were judged highly circular, with Nvidia's conditional commitment to OpenAI listed at up to roughly $100bn, consistent with the $105bn Ohio backstop cap in the August SEC filing, while OpenAI in turn commits hundreds of billions to clouds such as Oracle, which are themselves large Nvidia buyers. This week a third party drew the loop rather than inferring it. The second derivative still points to convergence: direct equity commitments have been parked near $40bn since May, split $30bn OpenAI, $10bn Anthropic and up to $2bn xAI, and Jensen Huang said in March that the $30bn cheque was probably the last. The stock of vendor financing remains close to double Lucent's 24% in 1999.
indicators.source_name: Sona Asset Management / CNBC / SEC filings

indicators.name_zh: 标普 50 日线上方比例
indicators.threshold_text_en: ≤40 red / 40-60 yellow / >60 green
indicators.note: 本期是本轮最陡的一次广度塌陷：S5FI 从 9/11 的 38.76 一路跌到 9/18 收 27.83，周内日线 37.77→34.59→30.81→30.81→27.83，两周累计 -28.2%，落入 52 周区间（17.69-73.90）的下四分位。宽口径交叉印证同向：全美约 4750 只普通股中 50 日线上方仅 31.4%、200 日线上方 43.2%（比值 0.73，短期显著落后长期）。同周指数层面却几乎没跌：纳指周涨 0.7%、标普周跌 0.1%，道指周跌 1.7% 为三连阴且 3 月以来最差，而标普前五权重同期还升了 0.26pt。指数靠少数权重维持、内部已经在下跌，是 2000-02 与 2021-11 共有的顶部形态。
indicators.note_en: This was the steepest breadth collapse of the cycle so far. S5FI fell from 38.76 on September 11 to a close of 27.83 on September 18, printing 37.77, 34.59, 30.81, 30.81 and 27.83 through the week — down 28.2% in a fortnight and into the bottom quartile of its 17.69 to 73.90 52-week range. The broader tape agrees: across roughly 4,750 US common stocks, only 31.4% sit above their 50-day average and 43.2% above their 200-day, a 0.73 ratio that says short-term participation is lagging badly. Yet the indices barely moved. The Nasdaq rose 0.7% on the week and the S&P slipped 0.1%; only the Dow fell meaningfully, down 1.7% for a third straight losing week and its worst since March. Meanwhile the S&P's top-five weight actually rose 0.26pt. An index held up by a handful of names while the average stock declines is the shape both February 2000 and November 2021 took.

indicators.threshold_text_en: >20 red / 5-20 yellow / <5 green
indicators.note: SEC EDGAR Form 4 直聚 12 家、窗口 8/21-9/20、共 195 份：卖出 $8.928 亿 / 买入 $12.18 万，比值 7327x（买盘近零，比值对分母极敏感，value 取上限 99）。两个方向相反的细节：① 卖出绝对额 $9.383 亿→$8.928 亿，环比 -4.9%，为连续 4 期抬升后的首次回落；② 比值却由 3171x 跳到 7327x（+131%），纯粹由买盘从 $29.6 万塌到 $12.18 万造成——这正是本指标在买盘近零时的失真区，必须以绝对额为准。结构仍高度集中：NVDA 单家 $6.607 亿占 74%（上期 $6.530 亿、占 70%），其次 AMD $7188 万、MSFT $6415 万、MU $3876 万、META $3285 万。唯一买盘 $12.18 万仍全部来自 TSM。
indicators.note_en: Aggregating Form 4 filings straight from SEC EDGAR across the 12-name basket over August 21 to September 20, 195 filings in all, gives $892.8m of open-market sales against $121,844 of purchases, a 7,327x ratio. The buy side is effectively zero, so the ratio is hypersensitive to its denominator and the stored value is capped at 99. Two details point opposite ways. Dollar sales fell from $938.3m to $892.8m, down 4.9% and the first decline after four straight weekly increases. But the ratio jumped from 3,171x to 7,327x, a 131% move caused entirely by purchases collapsing from $296k to $122k — precisely the distortion zone this metric enters when buying stops, which is why the absolute sale figure is the one to read. The mix stays concentrated: Nvidia alone accounted for $660.7m, or 74% of the total, against $653.0m and 70% last week, followed by AMD at $71.9m, Microsoft $64.2m, Micron $38.8m and Meta $32.8m. Every dollar of buying again came from TSMC.

indicators.value_display: 升温·窗口后移 (Anthropic 推 11 月)
indicators.threshold_text: 洪流 10+ 红 / 升温 3-9 黄 / 平静 <3 绿
indicators.threshold_text_en: Flood of 10+ red / heating up 3-9 yellow / quiet under 3 green
indicators.note: 本期主线是时间表整体后移而非降温。Anthropic 的挂牌预期由 10 月推到 11 月（公开 S-1 定于 9 月底、路演最早 10 月中，承销团 GS/MS/JPM/Citi，讨论区间最高 $2 万亿，二级隐含 $8851.8 亿）；OpenAI 仍维持 9/12 正式推到 2027 的口径。加热侧新增一条：数据中心运营商 Vantage 正评估以约 $1000 亿估值 IPO 或出售、拟募约 $100 亿，将是史上最大数据中心 IPO；Cerebras 已于 5 月挂牌（CBRS，20 倍超额认购）。未来 6 个月已宣告的 AI 相关发行仍在 7-9 家上沿，未达 10+ 洪流阈值——但若 Anthropic 与 Vantage 同落在 11 月前后，这个阈值会在一个月内被穿过。
indicators.note_en: The through-line this week was slippage rather than cooling. Anthropic's listing has moved from October to November, with the public S-1 due at the end of September, the roadshow mid-October at the earliest, Goldman, Morgan Stanley, JPMorgan and Citi on the ticket, talk of pricing up to $2trn and a secondary market implying $885.2bn. OpenAI's September 12 decision to push to 2027 stands. On the heating side, data centre operator Vantage is weighing an IPO or sale at roughly a $100bn valuation, raising about $10bn, which would be the largest data centre listing ever; Cerebras already came public in May at 20x oversubscription. Announced AI-related offerings for the next six months remain at the upper end of a seven-to-nine range, short of the ten-plus flood threshold — but if Anthropic and Vantage both land around November, that threshold falls inside a single month.

indicators.name_zh: 高收益债期权调整利差
indicators.threshold_text_en: >500 red / 350-500 yellow / <350 green
indicators.note: FRED BAMLH0A0HYM2 = 270bps（9/17 观测，即加息次日），与上期 270 持平；近五个观测日 270/270/276/271/265，9/15 一度触 276 后回落。本期看点全在分歧：同周 Fed 三年来首次加息、10 年美债盘中破 5.006%（2007 年 7 月以来最高）、Oracle 旗舰数据中心贷款跌到 89-91 美分，宽口径高收益利差却纹丝不动、距 350 黄线仍有 80bps。项目级信用已经在裂、指数级信用毫发无伤——这是「引线已点燃但火还没烧到干草堆」的典型读数，也是本期唯一没有跟随恶化的 trigger 指标。
indicators.note_en: FRED's BAMLH0A0HYM2 printed 270bps on September 17, the day after the hike, unchanged from last week; the five most recent observations run 270, 270, 276, 271 and 265, with a brief touch of 276 on September 15 that retraced. The story is the divergence. In the same week the Fed raised rates for the first time in three years, the 10-year yield traded through 5.006% for its highest level since July 2007, and Oracle's flagship data centre loan changed hands at 89 to 91 cents, index-level high yield did not move at all and sits 80bps inside the 350 amber line. Project-level credit is cracking while index credit is untouched — the classic reading of a fuse that is lit but has not yet reached the haystack, and the only trigger indicator that failed to deteriorate this week.

indicators.name_zh: 数据中心 ABS 利差
indicators.value_display: 走阔：旗舰贷款跌至 89-91 美分
indicators.value_display_en: Widening: flagship loan quoted at 89-91 cents
indicators.threshold_text: 走阔 50bps+ 红 / 稳定 黄 / 收窄 绿
indicators.threshold_text_en: 50bps+ wider red / stable yellow / tighter green
indicators.note: 本期由黄转红，是整份快照最重要的边际变化。Oracle 新墨西哥 Project Jupiter（1400 英亩、Stargate 供算枢纽）的约 $180 亿银团贷款被报价在 89-91 美分，已进入压力区间；起因是许可、电力与 2.2GW 燃气轮机供应申请被否导致项目延期约七个月，Santander、Jefferies 等承销行被迫留券、分销停滞。这是本轮第一次有旗舰级 AI 数据中心债务在二级市场被明确折价，9-11 个点的折让远超「走阔 50bps+」的红线判据。背景量价：2026 年 DC ABS/CMBS 发行 YTD $610 亿（2020 年仅约 $40 亿），H1 $170 亿、同比 +29%，一级市场并未关门；但投资人俱乐部普遍要求更高收益率，7 月 BlackRock 为 Meta El Paso 募的 $123 亿只拿到 $170 亿订单、被迫给到 10 年美债 +287.5bp、收益率 7%+。Oracle 自 7 月被 S&P 下调至 BBB- 后距垃圾级仅一档。
indicators.note_en: This moved from amber to red and is the single most important change in the snapshot. Roughly $18bn of syndicated loans backing Oracle's Project Jupiter in New Mexico — the 1,400-acre campus that anchors its Stargate compute deal with OpenAI — is being quoted at 89 to 91 cents on the dollar, squarely in stressed territory. The cause is a seven-month delay from permitting and power problems, including a rejected application tied to 2.2GW of gas turbine supply, which has left syndicate banks including Santander and Jefferies holding more paper than intended and the sell-down stalled. This is the first time in this cycle that flagship AI data centre debt has been visibly marked below par, and a nine-to-eleven-point discount is far beyond the 50bp widening the red threshold contemplates. The backdrop is volume without comfort: data centre ABS and CMBS issuance reached $61bn year to date against roughly $4bn in all of 2020, with $17bn in the first half alone, up 29% year on year, so the primary market has not shut. But investor clubs are demanding wider spreads, BlackRock's $12.3bn Meta El Paso deal in July drew only $17bn of orders and cleared at 287.5bp over Treasuries for a yield above 7%, and Oracle has sat one notch above junk since S&P's July downgrade to BBB-.

indicators.value_display: 观察 (0 起评级动作·杠杆再抬升)
indicators.value_display_en: Watch (no rating actions, leverage climbing again)
indicators.threshold_text: 已确认事件 红 / Watch 评级 黄 / 无 绿
indicators.threshold_text_en: Confirmed event red / on watch yellow / none green
indicators.note: 过去 90 天仍无评级下调、违约或压力交换的已确认事件，判定维持黄灯——但本期压力读数全面抬升。CoreWeave 9/17 宣布拟发 $30 亿可转债（另 $5 亿超额配售），最终上调至 $37 亿、票息 2.875%、2033 年到期、转股价 $97.85（较当日收盘 $79.88 溢价 22.5%），9/22 交割；公告当日股价跌 4-5% 跌破 $80、盘中一度 -8%。报表侧：截至 6 月底长期债务 $435 亿，债务权益比已由上期口径的 8.94 抬到 14.3，融资费用继续高于经营利润。Sona 的 $3.6 万亿图谱把 CoreWeave 与 Oracle 并列为相对盈利负债最重的两家。对照 Nebius 仍是现金 $80.4 亿、经营现金流为正的另一极，cohort 内部分化在拉大。市场已在用股价和转股溢价定价风险，评级机构还没动——这个时间差本身值得盯。
indicators.note_en: Still no confirmed downgrade, default or distressed exchange in the trailing 90 days, so this stays amber — but every pressure reading rose. CoreWeave announced a proposed $3.0bn convertible on September 17 with a $500m greenshoe and ended up pricing an upsized $3.7bn of 2.875% convertible senior notes due 2033, struck at $97.85, a 22.5% premium to that day's $79.88 close, settling September 22. The stock fell 4-5% on the announcement, broke below $80 and touched minus 8% intraday. On the balance sheet, long-term debt stood at $43.5bn at the end of June and the debt-to-equity ratio has climbed to 14.3 from the 8.94 carried last week, with financing costs still exceeding operating profit. Sona's $3.6trn map named CoreWeave and Oracle as the two most indebted relative to earnings. Nebius remains the other pole, with $8.04bn of cash and positive operating cash flow, so dispersion inside the cohort keeps widening. Equity and convertible markets are already pricing the risk; the rating agencies have not moved. That gap is the thing to watch.

indicators.name_zh: 全口径债务/Capex 流量比
indicators.threshold_text_en: >70 red / 50-70 yellow / <50 green
indicators.note: 周度增量：本周新增 1 笔 deal —— CoreWeave 上调后 $37 亿可转债（2.875%、2033 到期，9/17 定价），无单笔 ≥$100 亿。另回补一笔历史漏记：Hut 8 River Bend 数据中心 $32.5 亿投资级优先担保票据（6.192%、2042 到期，4/30 交割）。台账 YTD 累计由 $2017.7 亿升至 $2087.2 亿、共 19 笔（Hut 8 Beacon Point $42.5 亿因交割日未核实，留待 10/4 完整对账入账）。分子沿用 9/6 完整对账结果：中心 $6000 亿、区间 $5700-6500 亿；分母 2026E 全口径 AI 基建 capex $1.08 万亿 → 比值 55.6%，取 56%。本期最重要的交叉印证来自 Sona：全行业 AI 相关融资存量 $3.6 万亿（176 笔、202 个主体）——这是存量口径，不可与本指标的年度流量分子混用，但它说明台账（按下限读）与 MS 锚之间的缺口仍主要是私募信用与表外分笔。距 70% 红线 14pt，下次完整对账 10/4 之后。
indicators.note_en: Weekly increment: one new deal, CoreWeave's upsized $3.7bn convertible at 2.875% due 2033, priced September 17, and none at or above $10bn. One historical omission was also backfilled: Hut 8's $3.25bn of 6.192% investment-grade senior secured notes due 2042 for the River Bend project, closed April 30. The ledger's year-to-date total rises from $201.8bn to $208.7bn across 19 deals; Hut 8's $4.25bn Beacon Point financing is held back until its closing date can be confirmed at the October 4 reconciliation. The numerator carries over from the September 6 full reconciliation at a $600bn midpoint within a $570-650bn range, against a $1.08trn all-in 2026 AI infrastructure capex denominator, giving 55.6% and a rounded 56%. The most useful cross-check this week came from Sona, whose $3.6trn map of AI-related financing across 176 deals and 202 entities is a stock rather than an annual flow and must not be mixed into this numerator — but it does confirm that the gap between the ledger, which reads as a floor, and the Morgan Stanley anchor is still mostly private credit and off-balance-sheet tranches. Fourteen points below the 70% red line, with the next full reconciliation due after October 4.

indicators.name_zh: 行业 Token 量月度环比
indicators.threshold_text: 收缩 红 / 减速 黄 / 加速 绿
indicators.threshold_text_en: Contracting red / decelerating yellow / accelerating green
indicators.note: OpenRouter 官方 datasets API：近 30 日 509.9T tokens、前 30 日 292.7T，环比 +74.2%（数据截至 9/19，全平台 top50+other 口径）。绝对量首次突破 500T、较上期 463.3T 周环比 +10.1%；环比增速连续第 5 期抬升（+32.1%→+50.0%→+60.4%→+70.1%→+74.2%）。日度尾段 9/13-9/19 为 16.7/18.1/17.8/18.4/20.0/19.5/17.8T，工作日平台由上周的 17-19T 抬到 18-20T，9/17 单日 20.0T 创新高。在 Fed 加息、广度塌陷、旗舰贷款折价的同一周里，需求侧没有出现任何减速——这是本期最干净也最重要的反向证据。
indicators.note_en: OpenRouter's official datasets API shows 509.9 trillion tokens over the trailing 30 days against 292.7 trillion in the prior 30, a 74.2% increase, with data through September 19 on the platform-wide top-50-plus-other basis. Absolute volume cleared 500 trillion for the first time and rose 10.1% week on week from 463.3 trillion, while the month-over-month growth rate has now accelerated for a fifth straight period, running 32.1%, 50.0%, 60.4%, 70.1% and 74.2%. Daily prints for September 13-19 were 16.7, 18.1, 17.8, 18.4, 20.0, 19.5 and 17.8 trillion, lifting the weekday plateau from last week's 17-19 trillion to 18-20 trillion, with September 17 setting a record at 20.0 trillion. In the same week the Fed hiked, breadth collapsed and a flagship loan was marked down, demand showed no deceleration whatsoever. It is the cleanest and most important piece of contrary evidence in this issue.

indicators.threshold_text: 环比跌 >15% 或普遍过剩 红 / 温和阴跌·空置上升 黄 / 稳定或紧俏 绿
indicators.threshold_text_en: Down 15%+ or broad oversupply red / mild drift lower with rising vacancy yellow / stable or tight green
indicators.note: AIMultiple 云 GPU 价格指数（9/14 周度快照、9/20 复核）：H100 按需中位 $3.25/hr、H200 $4.40/hr、B200 $6.52/hr；同源另给出按需中位过去 90 日上涨约 7% 至 $3.36/hr，方向是涨不是跌。对照台账上期 cohort 中位 $3.32、9 月 Thunder Compute 报告的 neocloud 中位 $4.17，主力档位与区间完全重叠，无 >15% 跌幅。可得性数据同向印证供给偏紧：确认有货的挂牌比例 MI300X 仅 7%、B300 11%、B200 16%，而老代 H100 为 33%——紧缺集中在新代，老代松动但未崩价。算力商品价格是本体系里唯一直接看供需成交价的指标，目前没有 2000 年暗光纤式塌陷的迹象。
indicators.note_en: AIMultiple's cloud GPU price index, snapshotted September 14 and rechecked September 20, puts the median on-demand H100 at $3.25 an hour, the H200 at $4.40 and the B200 at $6.52, and separately notes the on-demand median has risen about 7% over the past 90 days to $3.36. The direction is up, not down. Against the ledger's $3.32 cohort median and Thunder Compute's $4.17 neocloud median from its September report, the core tier and the range overlap completely, with nothing close to a 15% decline. Availability data points the same way: confirmed in-stock listings run just 7% for MI300X, 11% for B300 and 16% for B200, versus 33% for the older H100 — scarcity is concentrated in the newest silicon while the previous generation has loosened without breaking on price. This is the only indicator in the framework that reads the clearing price of compute directly, and there is still no sign of a 2000-style dark-fibre collapse.

indicators.value_display: 平稳·披露停滞第 7 期
indicators.value_display_en: Flat, seventh period without new disclosure
indicators.threshold_text: 减速 红 / 平稳 黄 / 加速 绿
indicators.threshold_text_en: Decelerating red / flat yellow / accelerating green
indicators.note: 沿用 2026-08-17 值（数据源暂不可用）：连续第 7 期无新披露，as_of 不前移。Anthropic 仍是 7 月底 $650 亿 run-rate（5 月 $470 亿、4 月 $300 亿，月增量由 $170 亿降至 $90 亿），OpenAI 仍是 8 月 Brockman 内部信的 $400 亿。二阶导仍是「一加一减」：Anthropic 绝对增量收敛、OpenAI 从春季 $250 亿平台重新起量；投资人预期 Anthropic 年底落在 $1000-1200 亿。读点被再次推迟——Anthropic 公开 S-1 定于 9 月底、挂牌已由 10 月推到 11 月，届时首次出现的经审计收入将一次性替换掉这个停滞 7 期的锚。
indicators.note_en: Carrying the value as of 2026-08-17 (source unavailable): a seventh consecutive period with no fresh disclosure, so the as-of date does not roll forward. Anthropic remains at the $65bn run rate reported at the end of July, against $47bn in May and $30bn in April, with the monthly increment decaying from $17bn to $9bn, and OpenAI remains at the $40bn cited in Greg Brockman's August internal note. The second derivative is still one up and one down: Anthropic's absolute increments are converging while OpenAI has re-accelerated off its $25bn spring plateau, and investors expect Anthropic to finish the year between $100bn and $120bn. The read point has slipped again — Anthropic's public S-1 is due at the end of September and the listing has moved from October to November, at which point audited revenue will replace an anchor that has now been frozen for seven weeks.

indicators.threshold_text_en: ≤50 red / 50-65 yellow / >65 green
indicators.note: 季度调查无新整体读数，McKinsey Q1 2026 的 72%（2024 年 55%、2020 年 20%）续为主锚，Presenc AI 的全球 2000 强口径 78% 亦不变。本期新增三条 Gartner/IDC 侧的量化：① Q1 出货或更新的企业应用中 80% 已内嵌至少一个 AI agent，但真正有 agent 跑在生产环境的组织只有 31%；② Gartner 预计到 2026 年底 40% 的企业应用将带任务型 agent（2025 年不足 5%）；③ AI 预算已占企业 IT 总支出平均 14.6%，前四分位超 22%。「部署广、价值捕获窄」的裂口仍在（仅 37% 报告 EBIT 层面正贡献），但采用率本身离 65% 黄线还有 7pt，绿灯不变。
indicators.note_en: No new headline survey this quarter, so McKinsey's 72% from Q1 2026 remains the anchor, against 55% in 2024 and 20% in 2020, with Presenc AI's 78% Global 2000 figure also unchanged. Three new quantifications arrived from the Gartner and IDC side. Eighty percent of enterprise applications shipped or updated in Q1 now embed at least one AI agent, yet only 31% of organisations actually have an agent running in production. Gartner expects 40% of enterprise applications to carry task-specific agents by the end of 2026, up from under 5% in 2025. And AI budgets now average 14.6% of total enterprise IT spend, with the top quartile above 22%. The gap between broad deployment and narrow value capture persists — only 37% report a positive contribution at the EBIT line — but adoption itself sits seven points clear of the 65% amber line and the reading stays green.

indicators.threshold_text: 负增长 红 / 减速 黄 / 加速 绿
indicators.threshold_text_en: Negative red / decelerating yellow / accelerating green
indicators.note: 沿用 2026-09-10 值（数据源暂不可用）：本期无新季度读数，as_of 不前移。台账维持：Oracle Q1 FY27 RPO $6640 亿（同比 +$2090 亿即 +46%、环比 +$260 亿），OCI 收入同比 +121%、GPU 利用率 97.9%；MSFT 商业 RPO $6780 亿（+84% YoY、久期 2.3 年）、AWS $4960 亿（久期 6.4 年，较 2025 年底 $2440 亿/4.1 年大幅拉长）、Google backlog $5140 亿，四家合计约 $2.3 万亿。下一批硬读数集中在 10 月下旬的 Q3 财报季。
indicators.note_en: Carrying the value as of 2026-09-10 (source unavailable): no new quarterly disclosure this period, so the as-of date is left unchanged. The ledger holds — Oracle's Q1 FY27 remaining performance obligations of $664bn, up $209bn or 46% year on year and $26bn sequentially, with OCI revenue up 121% and GPU utilisation at 97.9%; Microsoft's commercial RPO of $678bn, up 84% with a 2.3-year weighted duration; AWS at $496bn on a 6.4-year duration, sharply extended from $244bn and 4.1 years at the end of 2025; and Google's $514bn backlog. The four together total roughly $2.3trn. The next batch of hard numbers arrives with Q3 earnings in late October.

indicators.value_display: 加速·但本期 SOTA 零位移
indicators.value_display_en: Accelerating, but zero SOTA movement this week
indicators.threshold_text: 连续两季无实质提升 红 / 提升有限·倍增拉长 黄 / 90 天内困难基准实质刷新 绿
indicators.threshold_text_en: Two quarters without material gains red / limited gains with lengthening doubling time yellow / a hard benchmark materially refreshed within 90 days green
indicators.note: ① 困难基准（BenchLM 9/18 榜，对比台账上期）：HLE SOTA 仍为 Claude Fable 5.1 65.0%（Opus 5 64.7 / Mythos 5 64.5 / Muse Spark 1.1 62.1 / GPT-5.4 Pro 58.7）；ARC-AGI-3 SOTA 仍为 GPT-6 Astra 62.7%（标准 harness；其 provider-adapter 口径的 99.9% 已被 ARC Prize 与第三方复核指出不可直接比较），Opus 5 30.2、GPT-5.6 Sol 7.8。两项本期均与上期逐位相同——这是自 8 月中以来第一次出现 SOTA 零位移。② 发布密度：9/14-9/20 无旗舰级发布，上一批是 9/1 Fable 5.1、9/2 Gemini 3.8 Flash、9/3-9/8 GPT-6 Astra 的连发。③ METR：官方页面仍停在 TH1.1、最后更新 2026-05-08，无新期。判定仍为绿：90 天窗口内的位移量级依旧极大（ARC-AGI-3 7.8%→62.7%、FrontierMath T4 35.4%→97.6%），远超「≥10% 相对提升」的绿灯门槛。但本期是本轮第一次出现「零新 SOTA + 零旗舰发布」的组合，若再延续一个季度即触发黄灯判据，需连续跟踪。
indicators.note_en: On hard benchmarks, the September 18 BenchLM boards leave both anchors exactly where they were. Claude Fable 5.1 still leads Humanity's Last Exam at 65.0%, ahead of Opus 5 at 64.7%, Mythos 5 at 64.5%, Meta's Muse Spark 1.1 at 62.1% and GPT-5.4 Pro at 58.7%. GPT-6 Astra still holds ARC-AGI-3 at 62.7% on the standard harness, with Opus 5 at 30.2% and GPT-5.6 Sol at 7.8%, and its 99.9% provider-adapter figure flagged by ARC Prize and outside reviewers as not directly comparable. Both numbers are digit-for-digit unchanged, the first week with zero SOTA movement since mid-August. On release density, nothing frontier-class shipped between September 14 and 20; the last cluster was Fable 5.1 on September 1, Gemini 3.8 Flash on September 2 and GPT-6 Astra across September 3-8. METR's page still shows Time Horizon 1.1, last updated May 8, with no new release. The call stays green because the 90-day displacement remains enormous — ARC-AGI-3 from 7.8% to 62.7% and FrontierMath Tier-4 from 35.4% to 97.6%, far beyond the 10% relative improvement the green threshold asks for. But this is the first week of the cycle combining no new SOTA with no flagship release, and another quarter of that would meet the amber test.

indicators.name_zh: 会计造假/循环交易事件
indicators.threshold_text: 已确认 红 / 调查中 黄 / 无 绿
indicators.threshold_text_en: Confirmed red / under investigation yellow / none green
indicators.note: 本期复核确认：仍无针对 AI 龙头的已确认会计造假认定或 SEC 执法立案，计数 0，绿灯不变。但争议已从折旧年限扩到表外租约：Oracle 本期被披露持有约 $2610-2880 亿尚未起租的数据中心租约，这笔承诺按现行准则在起租前不入资产负债表；Sona 的 $3.6 万亿图谱里约 120 笔被判高度循环的交易同样牵涉收入确认与关联方口径——两者都属于「合规但难读」，不是造假。背景压力续存：① Michael Burry 的折旧质疑（5-6 年折旧 vs 真实 2-3 年经济寿命，估 2026-28 年多报利润约 $1760 亿）相关公司仍以利用率数据抗辩并持续通过审计；② SEC 公司融资部已在问询函中常规加入 AI 治理与 AI 用于财报流程的问题，首席会计师办公室点出第三方服务商与数据质量控制两项关切；③ Supermicro（E&Y 中途辞任）仍是唯一实体案例，非本期新事件。
indicators.note_en: Rechecked and confirmed: there is still no established accounting fraud finding or SEC enforcement action against a major AI name, the count stays at zero and the reading stays green. But the dispute has widened from depreciation lives to off-balance-sheet leases. Oracle was shown this week to be carrying roughly $261-288bn of data centre leases that have not yet commenced, commitments that under current standards stay off the balance sheet until they start, while the roughly 120 deals Sona flagged as highly circular within its $3.6trn map raise the same kind of revenue-recognition and related-party questions. Both are compliant but hard to read, not fraudulent. The background pressures persist. Michael Burry's depreciation critique — five-to-six-year schedules against a real economic life closer to two or three, implying roughly $176bn of overstated profit across 2026-28 — continues to be rebutted with utilisation data and continues to clear audit. The SEC's Division of Corporation Finance now routinely asks about AI governance and the use of AI in financial reporting in comment letters, with the Chief Accountant's office flagging third-party providers and data-quality controls. And Supermicro, where EY resigned mid-audit, remains the only concrete case and is not new.

indicators.threshold_text: 隐含加息 红 / 维持高利率 黄 / 隐含降息 绿
indicators.threshold_text_en: Hike priced in red / on hold at high rates yellow / cut priced in green
indicators.note: 本期是本指标自建立以来最硬的一次确认：加息由定价变成事实。9/16 FOMC 以 12-0 票加息 25bp，目标区间由 3.50-3.75% 升至 3.75-4.00%，为 2023 年以来首次加息，理由是通胀持续显著高于 2%（8 月 CPI 同比 3.4%、核心 2.4%）。同日发布的 SEP 点阵图显示 18 人中 16 人认为年内还有一次加息、其中 4 人看两次。前瞻定价并未随落地而松动：CME FedWatch 9/20 对 10/28 再加息 25bp 给出 59.7%（另一源 58%）。跨资产同步收紧：10 年美债周内升破 5.006%，为 2007 年 7 月以来最高。加息周期重启是本体系里唯一已经从预期兑现为事实的 trigger，也是 1999-06 与 2021-11 两个历史时点共有的引线。
indicators.note_en: This is the hardest confirmation this indicator has produced since it was created: the hike stopped being priced and started being real. On September 16 the FOMC voted 12-0 to raise rates by 25bp, lifting the target range from 3.50-3.75% to 3.75-4.00%, the first increase since 2023, citing inflation still well above the 2% goal with August CPI at 3.4% and core at 2.4%. The dot plot released the same day showed 16 of 18 participants expecting another hike this year and four seeing two more. Forward pricing did not soften on the news: CME FedWatch put the odds of a further 25bp at the October 28 meeting at 59.7% as of September 20, with another source at 58%. Cross-asset confirmation came from the 10-year Treasury, which traded through 5.006% during the week for its highest level since July 2007. A restarted tightening cycle is the only trigger in this framework that has moved from expectation to fact, and it is the fuse that June 1999 and November 2021 had in common.

indicators.name_zh: 资本开支指引市场反应
indicators.threshold_text: 系统性惩罚 红 / 偶发惩罚 黄 / 奖励 绿
indicators.threshold_text_en: Systematic punishment red / occasional punishment yellow / rewarded green
indicators.note: 由绿转黄：上周还在被奖励的两家，本周被同一笔账单打了回来。① Oracle 9/11 曾因 $6640 亿 RPO 盘中 +7%，本周 9/18 收跌 3.8%（$150.59→$147.61），触发点是 Project Jupiter $180 亿贷款被报价 89-91 美分、以及 Sona 的 $3.6 万亿图谱把它列为最重债主体之一——市场第一次不是在评判 capex 本身，而是在评判偿付这笔 capex 的债。② CoreWeave 9/17 宣布 $30 亿可转债当日跌 4-5%、跌破 $80，盘中一度 -8%。③ 但惩罚仍是点状而非系统性：同日微软微跌、亚马逊小涨，纳指整周仍涨 0.7%。判为黄灯（偶发惩罚）：市场尚未全面拒绝 AI capex，但定价标准已从「订单可见度」前移到「融资可得性」——讲不清怎么还钱的公司开始挨打。
indicators.note_en: Green to amber: the two names rewarded last week were sent back by the same bill. Oracle, which traded up as much as 7% on September 11 on a $664bn backlog, closed down 3.8% on September 18 at $147.61 from $150.59, the trigger being the $18bn Project Jupiter loan quoted at 89-91 cents and Sona's $3.6trn map naming it one of the most indebted entities in the chain. For the first time the market was not judging the capex itself but the debt servicing it. CoreWeave fell 4-5% on September 17 on announcing a $3bn convertible, breaking below $80 and touching minus 8% intraday. The punishment is still selective rather than systematic: Microsoft dipped slightly the same day, Amazon edged higher, and the Nasdaq still gained 0.7% on the week. Hence amber. Investors have not rejected AI capex broadly, but the test has moved forward from order visibility to financing availability, and companies that cannot explain how the bill gets paid are now being marked down.

indicators.value_display: 增加·黄仁勋公开反驳泡沫论
indicators.value_display_en: Increasing, Huang publicly pushes back on bubble talk
indicators.threshold_text: 普遍承认过热 红 / 部分对冲 黄 / 无 绿
indicators.threshold_text_en: Broad acknowledgement of overheating red / partial hedging yellow / none green
indicators.note: 存量表态未变：Altman 称投资者整体过度兴奋、类比互联网泡沫；Pichai 警告市场存在非理性、没有公司能幸免包括自家；Nadella 称若增长只来自投资那就是泡沫；Dimon 称自己比多数人更担心。本期新增两条：① 黄仁勋在 CBS 长访谈（周日播出）中正面反驳泡沫论，称过去六个月行业实质上已切换到「高产能爬坡模式」、AI 产品已经盈利且被广泛采用——值得注意的是报道明确写明该访谈发生在同业 AI 高管的警告把芯片股打下去数日之后，即反驳本身证明对冲声量在升高；② Altman、黄仁勋、Cook、Musk、Bezos、Pichai、Dell、Dimon 八人已确认出席 9/24 白宫特朗普-习会晤国宴，议题含 AI 护栏与芯片准入。口头对冲广泛、且首次出现龙头 CEO 公开反击，但仍非「普遍承认过热」的集体转向，维持黄灯。
indicators.note_en: The standing positions are unchanged: Altman saying investors are collectively over-excited and drawing the dot-com parallel, Pichai warning of irrationality and that no company is immune including his own, Nadella arguing that growth coming only from investment is the tell, and Dimon saying he worries more than most. Two things are new. Jensen Huang used an extended CBS interview aired Sunday to push back directly, arguing the industry has effectively shifted into high production ramp mode over the past six months and that AI products are already profitable and widely adopted. That is notable because the coverage places the interview days after warnings from rival AI leaders knocked chip stocks lower, so the rebuttal is itself evidence that hedging has grown louder. Separately, Altman, Huang, Cook, Musk, Bezos, Pichai, Dell and Dimon are all confirmed for the September 24 Trump-Xi state dinner at the White House, with AI guardrails and chip access on the agenda. Verbal hedging is broad and now draws public pushback from the sector's most visible CEO, but it still falls short of a collective admission of overheating, so the reading stays amber.
